nodes.label: Ultracite Code Standards
nodes.rationale: Zero-config preset chosen to enforce strict, automated code quality so review effort can focus on business logic, naming, architecture, edge cases and UX instead of formatting.

nodes.label: Auto Update
nodes.rationale: Checks GitHub Releases on launch, downloads and installs updates, then restarts so users always run the latest version; only works for open-source GitHub repos or with a custom update server.

nodes.label: Accessibility (Semantic HTML & ARIA)
nodes.rationale: Meaningful alt text, heading hierarchy, labeled inputs, keyboard handlers and semantic elements instead of divs with roles.

nodes.label: Async & Promises Guidelines
nodes.rationale: async/await with awaited return values and meaningful try-catch gives more readable and correct asynchronous code than promise chains.

nodes.label: Business Logic Correctness Beyond Biome
nodes.rationale: Automated linting cannot validate algorithms, naming, architecture, edge cases, UX or documentation, so human attention is directed there.

nodes.label: Code Organization
nodes.rationale: Focused functions, named boolean conditions and early returns reduce cognitive complexity and nesting.

nodes.label: Error Handling & Debugging
nodes.rationale: Throw descriptive Error objects, avoid catch-and-rethrow and remove console/debugger/alert from production so failures stay actionable.

nodes.label: Framework-Specific Guidance
nodes.rationale: Per-framework idioms (Next.js Image/metadata/Server Components, React 19 ref-as-prop, class/for attributes in Solid/Svelte/Vue/Qwik) prevent framework anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Modern JavaScript/TypeScript Practices
nodes.rationale: Arrow functions, for...of, optional chaining, nullish coalescing, template literals, destructuring and const-by-default favor clarity over brevity.

nodes.label: Performance Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Avoid spread accumulators in loops, hoist regex literals, use specific imports, avoid barrel files and prefer optimized image components.

nodes.label: React & JSX Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Function components, top-level hooks, stable keys, semantic HTML and correct dependencies keep components predictable and accessible.

nodes.label: Security Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Avoid eval, document.cookie assignment and unnecessary dangerouslySetInnerHTML; add rel=noopener to target=_blank links and sanitize user input.

nodes.label: Testing Standards
nodes.rationale: Assertions inside it()/test(), async/await instead of done callbacks, no committed .only/.skip and flat suites for readable tests.

nodes.label: Type Safety & Explicitness
nodes.rationale: Prefer unknown over any, const assertions, type narrowing and named constants so intent is explicit and compiler-checked rather than asserted.

nodes.label: Content Security Policy (script-src 'self')
nodes.rationale: Restricting script sources to 'self' blocks injected or remote scripts, hardening the renderer against XSS.

nodes.label: Electron Context Isolation
nodes.rationale: Context isolation is enabled by project preference to keep renderer code separated from privileged Electron APIs.

nodes.label: Custom Title Bar (titleBarStyle: hidden)
nodes.rationale: Hidden native title bar lets the app render its own custom title bar for a native-feeling desktop UI.
